brief:
Israel is expanding forced expulsions and destroying infrastructure across the occupied West Bank as part of a strategy to impose a "new reality" on the territory, Al Jazeera English reported. Analysts say the escalation aims to solidify Israeli control over Palestinian lands.

The campaign involves demolishing Palestinian homes and facilities while forcibly displacing residents from their communities. The strategy reflects efforts to reshape the demographic and physical landscape of the West Bank through coercive measures.
dek: Israel escalates forced expulsions and infrastructure destruction with the goal of imposing 'new reality', analysts say.
title: Israel escalates West Bank expulsions to cement control
